description: This file contains a Unity C# script for switching shaders on mobile platforms, including classes for shader replacement logic and a custom inspector drawer.

classes.name: AutoMobileShaderSwitch
classes.description: Main class for switching shaders on mobile platforms during runtime.

classes.name: AutoMobileShaderSwitch.ReplacementDefinition
classes.description: Defines a pair of original and replacement shaders for switching.

classes.name: AutoMobileShaderSwitch.ReplacementList
classes.description: Contains a list of ReplacementDefinitions for shader switching.

classes.name: ReplacementListDrawer
classes.description: Custom property drawer for editing ReplacementList in the Unity Editor.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Performs shader replacement on enabled platforms.

methods.name: OnGUI
methods.description: Draws custom inspector GUI for ReplacementList.

methods.name: GetPropertyHeight
methods.description: Calculates height of the custom inspector GUI.
